note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, authored none of 9c3697d0d1 or 439a413ffd). draft-ietf-idr-linklocal-capability-06 Section 6: "If the Next Hop field is malformed, the implementation MUST handle the malformed UPDATE message using the approach of "treat-as-withdraw", as described in section 7.3 of [RFC7606]." The only change to TestLinkLocalCapabilityMalformedThirtyTwoOctet and TestLinkLocalCapabilityWellFormedThirtyTwoOctet (9c3697d0d1) is the call ValidateUpdateRFC7606AddPath(attrs, false, false, true, nil, true) becoming ValidateUpdateRFC7606Peer(attrs, false, false, true, nil, true, false); the deleted wrapper's body at 9c3697d0d1^ was exactly that call with acceptASSet false, so the input reaching the producer is unchanged and the AS_PATH [65001] fixture holds no set. Assertions unchanged: the negative requires exact TreatAsWithdraw, AttrCode 14 and the exact draft Section 6 description for link-local/global, global/global, global/unspecified and multicast/link-local; the positive requires exact ActionNone for global/link-local, unspecified/link-local and link-local/link-local, the forms Section 6 admits. The reactor producer session_validation_receive.go still calls ValidateUpdateRFC7606Peer with the session's capability-77 state, which reaches validateLinkLocalNextHopPair (rfc7606.go). The receiving-pair reactor units are unchanged and their earlier reading stands. Units ran green at HEAD.
